scope: scripts/qualify_graphical_changes.py (gr3) on a frozen Debug build of 6f82e70 (D:\wp\b56, git-archived sources with source-manifest.json) in a fresh owned scratch CPU 1511-1 PN V4.1 under TIA Portal V21 Update 3: the genuine V21 exports Tgp_FC_LAD and Tgp_FC_FBD (an FB calling the scratch's FC TiaMcp_IsEnabled) imported with the project culture and an extra Bool input; per language call_parameter_set moved the Enable argument to EnableAlternate, graphical_network_patch replaced one Access in place and graphical_network_insert added a copy of the network with fresh object IDs, each with checkpoint, compile, native preservation readback and save, change_status equal to the apply result and a complete snapshot differing only in the edited block; on LAD each kind first refused a wrong previewHash (PreviewMismatch) without stages or checkpoint; a fresh owned Portal reopen showed the identical state; from there one change per kind was applied again and restored from its checkpoint into a new directory equal to the reopened state; nine typed prepare refusals (NetworkNotFound, CallNotFound, ParameterNotFound, UnresolvedNetworkReference, InvalidNetworkPatch, UnsupportedLanguage, LanguageConversionNotSupported, InvalidSimaticML and AccessWiringUnsupported for call_connection_set) left the PLC software unchanged.
limitations: Two genuine V21 FlgNet/v5 fixtures (one LAD and one FBD network, each an FB calling an FC) in one owned scratch CPU 1511-1 PN V4.1.

graphical_network_patch is qualified for in-place Access replacement only: TIA renumbers UIds and orders Access parts first on import, so patches that add or remove fragments fail closed with NativePreservationMismatch (exploratory probe, same day) and need their checkpoint.
call_connection_set is refused before any change: TIA V21 import rejects an Access without a wire and an Access on several wires (exploratory probe, same day).

Engineering only; nothing is downloaded or simulated. Trials gr1 (build b54, stopped on the runner's own assertion in its restore phase) and gr2 (build b55, passed without change_status calls) are retained and not cited.
